summary: Applied 3 draft question repairs: simplified q1, simplified q3, and removed q4.

items.title: `sdd-forge.flow` skill が明示されているため、該当手順だけ確認して、この依頼がフロー操作ではなく QA 構造チェックである前提で進めます。指定されたローカル skill パスがこの worktree には存在しないようです。依頼内容自体は有限な構造レビューなので、提示された QA だけを対象に判定します。### 1. q1 includes rationale
items.rationale: Removed the explanatory second sentence so q1 asks only for the goal-confirmation decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question now asks only whether upgrade evidence should use a dedicated upgrade-result.json.

items.title: 2. q3 includes a proposed answer shape
items.rationale: Removed the proposed raw-log and summary-count shape so q3 asks only which result states must be distinguishable.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question now asks only whether success, no-change, updated, and failure states are sufficient.

items.title: 3. q4 asks internal implementation details and includes rationale
items.rationale: Removed q4 from the draft QA list because the artifact generation entry point is an implementation-policy detail for spec writing.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[] no longer includes the question asking whether artifact generation belongs in sdd-forge upgrade or a flow-specific command.
